description_for_human: Returns correlated privilege-escalation incidents from the Hive engine.
description_for_model: Retrieves the latest Hive privilege-escalation report, including individual agent signals, per-user correlated incidents with risk scores, and recommended containment actions. Use whenever the user asks about privilege escalation, role changes, token/Kerberos misuse, lateral movement, incidents, or recommended response.

functions.name: getHiveReport
functions.description: Get the latest Hive privilege-escalation report: agent signals, correlated incidents, and recommended response actions.
